name: Instinkt mortido
source:
For some, "Sovenok" pioneer camp is an anomaly; for others, it is a divine creation. It cannot be left, cannot be changed; any action here is devoid of long-term consequences. Now the only clear thing is that this place is much more complex than it seemed the first week, before everything locked in an endless circle of the same scenario with only one unstable variable - Semyon. 

The situation becomes less dire when it turns out that the camp is not a holistic structure in itself. Thousands of microworlds, united in one Space, hide their prisoners in the looped week. Each of them has the same history, but completely different paths of development. And having spent hundreds of years without a hint of change, not everyone was able to maintain their sanity.
translation:
对于一些人来说，“索维诺克”先锋营是一种异常现象；对于其他人来说，这是一个神圣的创造。不能离开，不能改变；这里的任何行动都不会产生长期后果。现在唯一清楚的是，这个地方比第一周看起来要复杂得多，之前一切都锁定在同一场景的无限循环中，只有一个不稳定的变量——谢苗。

当事实证明营地本身并不是一个整体结构时，情况就变得不那么可怕了。数以千计的微型世界联合在一个空间中，将囚犯隐藏在循环的一周中。他们各自有着相同的历史，却截然不同的发展道路。而数百年没有丝毫变化，并不是所有人都能保持理智。
